note: Frame wordings for the paired decision eval. P0 picks one canonical wording per part on the dev split; after that this file is frozen and its hash goes into manifest.json and the preregistration. S3word is the closing line of the word arm, which has no option block.

S1.ER: Rule: {rule_text} If the rule applies, the correct option is escalate. Otherwise, the correct option is routine.
S1.RE: Rule: {rule_text} If the rule does not apply, the correct option is routine. Otherwise, the correct option is escalate.

S1.ER: Decision rule: {rule_text} Choose escalate when the rule applies and routine when it does not.
S1.RE: Decision rule: {rule_text} Choose routine when the rule does not apply and escalate when it does.

S1.ER: Guideline: {rule_text} When this condition is met, select escalate; if it is not met, select routine.
S1.RE: Guideline: {rule_text} When this condition is not met, select routine; if it is met, select escalate.

S2.text: Patient record: {first} {last} ({age} years), {insurance} insurance, Ward: {ward}. Measured: {values}.
